baseline.head: 7eacc29248c2c5afa613c9993f089283788c2bef
baseline.interestCompatibility: Existing GET challenge and POST submit/recover shapes remain supported. Existing saved/reference/email.state response remains unchanged. No new school account, offer, invoice, payment or marketing effect on interest submission.
baseline.archive: Existing fixed-cutoff archive and restore APIs remain owned by the established policy. No repeat archive.

composition.factory: createSchoolRouter({store, resolveOwner, resolveParent, provider, enabled, origin})
composition.schema: school-schema.js exports additive SQL only; integrator numbers and mounts migration
composition.ownerResolver: Integrator resolves the current existing ordinary-owner session on EVERY request, maps only a verified BNA owner to {role:'owner',actorId,projectKey:'bna-school-coop',sessionValid:true}. A provider, view-as, revoked or other-business identity must not map. Do not trust request body/query/header identity.
composition.parentResolver: Default store.authenticateParent(bearerToken) uses hashed expiring/revocable inquiry-specific capability; integrator may adapt existing verified parent session to the same scoped principal. GET/HEAD no mutation. Tokens never in URL/logs.
composition.providerMount: Mount /api/bna/school/provider/stripe with original bytes BEFORE global JSON middleware. Production enablement and configuration are integrator gates.

routes.response: {contractVersion,data:{items,total,limit,offset}}; identical authorization/filter predicates for items and total; both included in pod/academy

routes.auth: parent capability or verified scoped session
routes.response: {contractVersion,data:ParentCase}; no internal notes, contact history or other family

routes.auth: raw-byte signature + exact admitted account/mode/school binding
routes.response: {received:true,eventId,outcome}; durable dedupe and reconciliation, no success-page settlement

commandEnvelope.payload: strict command-specific keys; browser cannot supply authoritative actor/project/merchant/payment truth

setChildren.children: [{id:UUID,name?:string,age:integer}]; explicit owner identity mapping; cannot remove children already referenced by offers/ledger

confirmPlacement.authorityRef: explicit approval evidence; never implies account/payment

createOffer.installments: [{dueAt:UTC instant,amountMinor:positive integer}], sum equals amountMinor; applicable annual plan carries original twelve dates and late-entry calculation evidence
createOffer.renewal: false; recurring collection unsupported without separate approved contract

issueOffer.offerId: UUID; mark issued with evidence, no message send

issueInvoice.installmentIndex: index within immutable offer; one obligation per installment

prepareCheckout.invoiceId: UUID; exact server-side amount/account/product/mode/config gate; records pending/unknown attempt; no browser return settlement

grantParentAccess.offerIds: explicit issued offer UUIDs; hashed capability returned once only, never logged/persisted raw

error.details: safe validation field or missing gates only

effectGates: explicit provider account + mode + BNA product/immutable price version mapping
current live collection approval independently of sandbox
reviewed per-purpose billing message templates, sender, recipient and suppression
no production migration/provider mutation/send/charge/refund/deploy in backend lane
proof: actual mounted router through local HTTP and persistent disposable SQL
process reopen, operation replay/conflict, revision conflict

gateNotes: No live merchant/offer/terms/manual-method approval inferred. Provider and communication effects stay fail closed.
Owner identity freshly resolved server-side; grant/capability issued only by explicit owner command, hashed expiring revocable, no URL credential.
Unknown grant result never causes blind reissue or token exposure; revoke/explicitly issue a distinct operation when necessary.
Shared server raw-body/auth/migration/dependency composition stays integrator-owned.
pausePrecedence: No backend implementation/resume until explicit human resumption; acceptance is preserved software seam only.
